text: 金十数据10月13日讯，上海市房地产交易中心官网“网上房地产”数据显示，10月11日（周日），上海二手房（含商业）单日网签成交1615套，刷新2026年下半年单日成交新高。这也是今年上海二手房第三次单日网签突破1600套，仅次于5月10日1664套、4月11日1632套的年内高点。综合市场数据与政策效应，业内普遍认为，上海楼市“银十”将延续稳步修复、结构分化的行情。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 13: According to data from the Shanghai Real Estate Trading Center's official website 'Online Real Estate,' on October 11 (Sunday), Shanghai's second-hand homes (including commercial) recorded 1,615 online signed transactions in a single day, setting a new single-day high for the second half of 2026. This is also the third time this year that Shanghai's second-hand home online signings have exceeded 1,600 in a single day, second only to the year's highs of 1,664 on May 10 and 1,632 on April 11. Based on market data and policy effects, the industry widely believes that Shanghai's property market 'Silver October' will continue a trend of steady repair and structural divergence.
